The '''Willcrusher''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Korvald Willcrusher]], a [[boss]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

== Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Reduces [[Dazed]] duration on you by 20% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as the [[Willcrusher Staff]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated by using inscribable staves. The [[inscription]] "Soundness of Mind", which reduces [[dazed]], can only be applied to [[shield]]s and [[focus item]]s.
* However, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
** A [[perfect]] [[staff]] drop with an [[Inherent modifier|inherent]] 20% Daze reduction
** [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
** [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
